items.summary: Recommendation: approve only three normal-priority, metadata-only routing repairs for 0daynews.com, amputeenews.com, and eastcoastrappers.com. Reject the pervypotion.com baseline as a production-adjacent proposal until its public evidence gap is narrowed; preserve only one bounded public inspection. Attribution is partial and low-volume, so authorize no unsupported revenue or causal claims, duplicate telemetry, production changes, credential/configuration changes, spending, schedules, or high-priority queue work. Proceed with these three routing repairs?
